overall_reason: The eight-tile navigation grid reaches every section at both widths, but the visitor scrolls past two screens of intro before any destination appears, and the tiles declare a hover look with no focus or pressed look.

score.reason: T-PHONE-NAV passes on the two-column tile grid at 375, while T-FIRST-RUN (CMP-017) and T-STATE-MATRIX (CMP-002) each find one gap.

findings.where: intro panel (#nav-button) and statement panel, 1440px and 375px, tiles/1440-00.png, tiles/1440-01.png, tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: The first screen at both widths holds only the sentence 'At Dropbox, our Brand Guidelines help us infuse everything we make with identity.' and the logo on a blank ground. The second screen holds a second statement in a blue square. The navigation grid (Framework, Voice & Tone, Logo, Typography, Color, Imagery, Motion, Iconography) first appears on the third screen (tiles/1440-02.png, tiles/375-02.png).
findings.before: Two screens of statement stand between the visitor and the eight guideline sections.
findings.after: Put the eight section tiles on the first screen, under one line of intro.
findings.why: People open a brand guidelines site to reach a section. Every visit starts with two screens of scrolling before any section can be chosen.
findings.title: Onboarding is short, optional and leads to the work

findings.where: nav.nav-wrapper tile links (Framework to Iconography), 1440px, tiles/1440-02.png
findings.evidence: declared_states counts 27 hover rules but 0 focus-visible, 1 focus and 0 active rules in 166 readable rules (2 sheets unreadable). The sweep's focus_ring check supports it: 'no visible focus indicator' on the 'Motion' tile (A11-003, the sweep's Floor).
findings.before: The section tiles change on hover, with no designed focus or pressed look.
findings.after: Give the tiles a focus-visible outline outside the coloured block and a one-step pressed change.
findings.why: Keyboard visitors and touch visitors get no sign of which tile they are on or that a tap registered.

strengths: At 375 the tile grid reflows to two columns with all eight sections and keeps each tile's label and picture (tiles/375-02.png).
The page has no competing buttons: the tiles are the only way forward, and each one names its section.
not_investigated: #nav-button: the 846x846 intro panel is a button named 'Navigation menu'. Clicking it changed only the scroll chevron within 600 ms (motion/t0-normal-000.png against t0-normal-600.png). What it does after that is not verified
fixed navigation covering focused tiles is the sweep's (focus_ring, 3 hits) and lens-a11y's
T-WHERE-AM-I: this is the home page, so no current mark is expected
T-FIELD-READ, T-ERROR-PATH, T-EMPTY-FIRST, T-TABLE-READ: no fields, actions, data regions or tables
inline validation and error placement after invalid input: the capture fills valid values and never types an invalid one
what the phone menu holds and how it opens and closes: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only
focus moving into an overlay and back to its trigger, scroll lock and backdrop click: not recorded by the capture
keyboard operation of custom widgets: lens-a11y
flows beyond the captured page and states reached only with real data
